# Visual Studio Code GUI Interface Description

## Window Header and System Information

- **Application Title Bar**: Displays "Visual Studio Code" on the left, with the current session title "Welcome - project - Visual Studio Code" centered.
- **System Date and Time**: "Oct 23 01:38" is displayed in the center of the header.
- **System Tray Icons**: Located on the far right of the header, including:
  - Network/Connection indicator
  - Sound/volume control
  - Power button
- **Window Control Buttons**: On the far right of the header, three standard window control buttons are present:
  - Minimize button (dash icon)
  - Maximize button (square icon)
  - Close button (X icon)

## Menu Bar

- **Main Menu Items**: A horizontal menu bar with the following items from left to right:
  - File
  - Edit
  - Selection
  - View
  - Go
  - Run
  - Terminal
  - Help

## Left Sidebar (Activity Bar)

- **Explorer Icon**: A folder icon at the top, indicating the Explorer view is active.
- **View Icons (from top to bottom)**:
  - Search icon (magnifying glass)
  - Source Control icon (branching lines)
  - Debug icon (play triangle)
  - Extensions icon (grid of squares)
- **Application Icons (vertical dock on the far left)**:
  - Google Chrome
  - Thunderbird Mail
  - Visual Studio Code (blue icon)
  - VLC Media Player
  - LibreOffice Writer
  - LibreOffice Calc
  - LibreOffice Impress
  - GIMP
  - File Manager
  - Ubuntu Software
  - Help (question mark)
  - Trash
- **Bottom Left Icons**:
  - User profile icon
  - Settings gear icon with a notification badge (number 1)
  - Outline and Timeline sections (collapsed)

## Main Content Area

### Welcome Page

- **Title**: "Visual Studio Code" in large font.
- **Subtitle**: "Editing evolved" in smaller font below the title.
- **Start Section**:
  - **New File...**: Icon of a document with a plus sign, with a mouse cursor hovering over it.
  - **Open File...**: Icon of an open folder.
  - **Open Folder...**: Icon of a folder.
  - **Connect to...**: Icon of a network connection.
- **Recent Section**:
  - Text: "You have no recent folders, open a folder to start."
- **Walkthroughs Section**:
  - **Get Started with VS Code**: Blue star icon, with text "Customize your editor, learn the basics, and start coding". This option is highlighted with a blue underline.
  - **Learn the Fundamentals**: Light bulb icon, with text "Learn the Fundamentals".

### New File Dialog

- **Title**: "New File..."
- **Input Field**: "Select File Type or Enter File Name..." with a text input box.
- **File Type Options**:
  - **Text File**: Selected, with "Built-In" label. Shortcut "Ctrl + N" and "File" with a gear icon are displayed.
  - **Jupyter Notebook**: With "ipynb Support" label. "Notebook" label is displayed below.

## Bottom Status Bar

- **Status Indicators**:
  - **Git Status**: Three icons with "0" next to each (unstaged changes, staged changes, untracked files).
  - **File Count**: "0" next to a file icon.
  - **Line Count**: "0" next to a line icon.
- **Setting Checkbox**: "Show welcome page on startup" with a checked checkbox.
- **Bottom Right Icon**: A small icon resembling a person or user profile.

## Additional UI Elements

- **Tab Bar**: "Welcome" tab is active, with a close (X) button next to it.
- **Window Controls**: Two buttons on the top right of the main content area: a split view button (two vertical bars) and a more options button (three dots).
